intro: Red Silk Bandanas is a mission issued by Scout Riell on behalf of the People's Militia. It directs Alliance adventurers into the Deadmines to hunt down high-ranking Defias operatives and bring back their distinctive red silk masks as proof.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's no secret that the trademark of the Defias Gang is their Red Bandanas. But we've learned that the material from which these bandanas are made signifies the member's rank.

That being said, I want you to eliminate as many high ranking Defias members as you can. The highest ranking members will undoubtedly be found in VanCleef's secret hideout. When you're done bring me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof of their deaths and I will reward you. Good luck, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been reclaiming our land from the Defias gang? If so show me 10 Red Silk Bandanas as proof.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend! On behalf of The People's Militia I salute you for your efforts. Soon we will return this land to the people with help from brave souls like you.
